MPU_PROTECT_MODE.Name: MPU_PROTECT_MODE
MPU_PROTECT_MODE.Description: 0: disable; 1: protect reserv region; 2: rotect reserve region and set code region to read write; 3: protect reserve region and set code region to read only, data region to read write

SILENT.Name: SILENT
SILENT.Description: If SILENT=1, it will not display any compiling messsage

PFLOAT.Name: PFLOAT
PFLOAT.Description: If FLOAT=1, it will enable float point print when using nano newlib

NEWLIB.Name: NEWLIB
NEWLIB.Description: If NEWLIB=nano, it will use nano newlib, otherwise it will use normal newlib

NOGC.Name: NOGC
NOGC.Description: If NOGC=1, it will not gc any sections during compiling to save code size

ENABLE_COLOR.Name: ENABLE_COLOR
ENABLE_COLOR.Description: false: disable colour; true: enable colour

VERBOSE.Name: VERBOSE
VERBOSE.Description: If VERBOSE=1, it will display compiling message in verbose including compiling options

DR1X90_OUTPUT_DEV.Name: DR1X90_OUTPUT_DEV
DR1X90_OUTPUT_DEV.Description: console output to selected device; if OUTPUT_DEV=NONE, it will output nothing
